securityNotes: Read all 3 files in the skill directory in full (SKILL.md, references/framework-fixes.md, references/visual-checklist.md) plus the repo-root LICENSE. Fully self-contained: the only relative link in SKILL.md is `references/framework-fixes.md`, which resolves inside the skill directory; references/visual-checklist.md is bundled but not explicitly linked, and is included anyway since every file in the skill directory is vendored. No scripts, no bundled binaries -- framework-fixes.md contains only illustrative CSS/JS/JSX code snippets (not executable scripts shipped with the skill) plus one plain external URL (a webaim.org contrast-checker reference) and one plain link to the microsoft/playwright-mcp GitHub repo as a suggested (not required) reference implementation -- neither is a functional dependency the skill executes. No network calls, no credential access, no download-and-execute, no hidden or user-rule-bypassing instructions. This skill was checked specifically for self-containment inside claude-scholar, a much larger research-assistant collection (agents/, commands/, hooks/, plugins/, scripts/, templates/, utils/ at repo root); it does not reference any of those directories.

proposedEntry.name: web-design-reviewer
proposedEntry.description: Drives a four-phase live visual QA loop against a running website or web app (static HTML, React/Vue/Angular/Svelte SPAs, Next.js/Nuxt/SvelteKit, WordPress/Drupal, or any other web app): gather project/framework/styling info (auto-detecting from package.json, tailwind.config, etc.), capture screenshots and traverse pages at four viewports (375/768/1280/1920px) checking layout, responsive, accessibility and visual-consistency issues against named issue tables with severities, prioritize findings P1-P3, locate the offending source files by selector/component search and apply minimal framework-respecting fixes, then re-verify with before/after screenshots and a regression check. Ships a structured markdown report template (summary table, per-issue P1/P2 sections, unfixed-issues section) and a bundled reference with concrete before/after fix code for Pure CSS/SCSS, Tailwind, React+CSS Modules, styled-components/Emotion, Vue scoped styles, and Next.js, plus browser-console debugging snippets for detecting overflow and checking contrast.
inputs: running URL (local dev server, staging, or production)
browser automation capability (screenshot capture, page navigation, DOM retrieval)
access to project source code when making fixes
outputs: prioritized (P1-P3) issue report with before/after screenshots
source-level fixes applied at the offending files
unfixed-issue list with reasons and recommended actions
